versions.subject: New Rule - Linux - Auditd - Screencapture with Import Tool
versions.detection:
import:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: import
import_window_root:
    a1: '-window'
    a2: 'root'
    a3|endswith:
      - '.png'
      - '.jpg'
      - '.jpeg'
import_no_window_root:
    a1|endswith:
      - '.png'
      - '.jpg'
      - '.jpeg'
condition: import and (import_window_root or import_no_window_root)
versions.spl: type="EXECVE" a0="import" (a1="-window" a2="root" a3 IN ("*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg")) OR a1 IN ("*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg")
